candidates.statement: In general, FDA’s guidance documents do not establish legally enforceable responsibilities. 57 Instead, guidances describe the Agency’s current thinking on a topic and should be viewed only 58 as recommendations, unless specific regulatory or statutory requirements are cited. The use of 59 the word should in Agency guidance means that something is suggested or recommended, but 60 not required. 61
candidates.context: The recommendations outlined in the guidance pertain to submission of the sponsor’s tabulated 49 and analysis data sets in order to improve reviewability. These specifications also provide an 50 opportunity for dialogue between the sponsor and DHN to discuss issues related to trial design or 51 conduct that may affect the content of these data sets. These specifications are intended to 52 support the draft guidance for industry Noncirrhotic Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis With Liver 53 Fibrosis: Developing Drugs for Treatment (NASH Guidance) and reflect the data standards and 54 processes described in the FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide . 5

candidates.statement: Currently, the surrogate endpoints that are acceptable to DHN for a phase 3 trial to support 267 approval for treatment of noncirrhotic NASH with fibrosis are biopsy-based under 21 CFR 314 268 Subpart H - Accelerated Approval of New Drugs for Serious or Life-Threatening Illnesses. A 269 semi-quantitative scoring system that considers a core set of histological features known as the 270 NASH Clinical Research Network (CRN) Scoring System is used to assess NASH. Sponsors 271 may provide data for additional scoring systems conforming to CDISC standards. 10 Details on 272 alternative scoring should be described in the SDRG and ADRG. 273

candidates.statement: Subjects should have an overall histological diagnosis of NASH with liver fibrosis before the 275 NASH CRN Score applies. The NASH CRN Scoring System consists of an evaluation of fibrosis 276 using the NASH CRN Fibrosis Stage and the NAFLD Activity Score (NAS), where NAS 277 combines scores of steatosis, lobular inflammation, and hepatocellular ballooning. 11 For drug 278 development programs intended for treatment of noncirrhotic NASH with liver fibrosis, FDA has 279 accepted as critical inclusion criteria in NASH trials a NAS greater than or equal to 4 with at 280 least 1 point each in inflammation and ballooning along with a NASH CRN fibrosis score greater 281 than stage 1 fibrosis but less than stage 4 fibrosis. 282
